## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：文档和技能改成教 ADR-0146 D2 已落地的定制路径。两张承诺页（`capabilities/integrations`、`build-without-code`）不再说视图仪表板「可直接编辑」、不再把读者送去 Setup 的打包自动化页克隆流程，改说：装好的应用在 Studio 里定制，每处改动落在配对包 `<base>.custom`，视图/仪表板/报表/流程是覆盖，对象加 `__c` 字段，流程可本部署关闭或「新建类似」。另外六页（安装模式、对象扩展、元数据生命周期、权限集、CLI、元数据 API）补上 `__c`、`os migrate packageless-overlays`、无包写入已关闭、权限集只能「新建类似」等事实。技能：`objectstack-data` 教 `.custom` 里的对象扩展与 `__c` 保留后缀；`objectstack-automation` 教打包流程的同名声明覆盖（一个开关、挂起运行按旧版完成）与「新建类似」克隆门；`objectstack-platform` 在 #28509 那段之后补 ensure 门、customizations 读、卸载拒绝、「只有配对包能声明、依赖包改名」、三种不可覆盖类型走「新建类似」。三个技能各加一条 eval。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28577（N-30）。七张阻塞卡全部落地后，AI 作者读技能仍会写旧形态：无包覆盖行、不带 `__c` 的字段、双跑的克隆。每句教学都对照 `origin/main` `14208f2c` 上的代码核过，并在下文 What changes 里点名落地 PR。
- **风险与回滚**：纯文本，不改 spec、运行时或 UI。技能受 token 棘轮约束：新增全部由同文件删重复支付（布局树、搜索镜像维护表、公式旁白、日期/金额的 legacy→CEL 行、CEL 提示框、三段 `runAs`/`readonly` 收紧），三个被触文件上限下调到实测值(`objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 保持 6123)，无一上调。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：① `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` :134 新段；② `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` :50 新段与被删的两行 legacy→CEL；③ `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` 新节「Customizing an installed package's object」。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep -E 'objectstack-(data|platform|automation)/SKILL|examples-objects'`，预期四行都是 `(+0)`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（Tier H：技能面需授权批准）。

## What changes

Every taught sentence cites the PR that landed the behaviour, all on `origin/main` `14208f2c`:

- **Promise pages (Wanted 1).** `content/docs/capabilities/integrations.mdx` and `content/docs/build-without-code.mdx` say a customization is an item of the paired `.custom` package made in Studio (#28512 ensure door, #28711 / #28824 Studio customize + Restore package original, #28747 one surface, #28818 Setup metadata pages redirect to Studio), an object gains `__c` fields (#28724, #28860 Studio Add field), a flow is overridden or copied with "new similar" (#28693, #28621, #28668), the switch is on the item (#28420), and "new similar" for permission sets (#28636, #28669).
- **Measured pages (Wanted 3).** `deployment/install-modes.mdx` ("customise beside it" → the pair, linked); `data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` (the tenant row, the `__c` reservation under *Naming the fields you add*, a new section *Customizing an installed package's object* with the `hotcrm.custom` manifest shape — #28724, #28757, #28811, #28512); `concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` (the overlay tier no longer opens a write door, D11 note — #28850, #28689; the two-tier gate's first bullet; the `flow` Regime C row names the declared override, its pinning and "new similar" — #28693, #28500, #28621; the `object` row points at the `__c` extension); `permissions/permission-sets.mdx` (Studio's catalog address after #28818; "new similar" into the pair, never an override, D6 — #28636); `deployment/cli.mdx` (the `os migrate packageless-overlays` row and its occupancy row — #28689); `api/metadata-api.mdx` (the package-less `PUT` onto a packaged item is refused naming the pair; only the pair declares; the ensure and customizations doors — #28850, #28554, #28512, #28595). `automation/flows.mdx` and `plugins/packages.mdx` were read: neither teaches a customization path (their only "overlay" / "clone" hits are a flow-runner overlay and a plugin's export list), so neither moves.
- **Skills (Wanted 2).**
  - `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` § Object Extension Model: an installed package's object is extended from the pair, never replaced and takes no `overrides` (#28554 `declared_object`); every added field ends in `__c`, the suffix is refused outside the pair and an unsuffixed field is refused in it, at save / publish / install, `os validate` and `os build` (#28724, #28757); a base field changes only through `fieldPatches` (#28728, already taught); Studio's Add field writes the same `object_extension` item (#28811, #28860). `references/examples-objects.md`'s lock table reads "Edit", not "Edit (overlay)". Eval 5.
  - `objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` § Flow Types: a packaged flow is customized by a same-named declared override in the pair, armed in the base's place with one activation switch (`/toggle`) — #28693, #28770; a suspended run finishes on the body it started on — #28500; an undeclared same name is refused at publish — #28554; the clone door is "new similar": switched off, in the pair, never package-less, `409` for a flow holding a credential — #28621. Eval 13.
  - `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` § Manifest Reference, one paragraph after #28509's (not rewritten): the ensure door and its two manifest facts (`<ns>_custom`, `^<major>` — #28512), `GET /packages/:id/customizations` (#28595), the uninstall refusal (#28506), the write gate's rule for every other package — rename (#28554), and "new similar" for the three excluded types (#28636). Eval 11.
  - `objectstack-ui` and `objectstack-studio-admin`: the card lists them as unmeasured. `skills/objectstack-studio-admin` does not exist on `main` (neither under `skills/` nor `.claude/skills/`). `objectstack-ui` names no customization path (its "overlay" hits are the React page overlay and a chart series), so it does not move.
- **Token ratchet.** Paid in the same file, by deletion: platform — the project layout tree (its facts stay as one paragraph; the Template section and the Naming table already carry the barrels and the file pattern); data — the search-mirror maintenance table and the `formula`-mirror aside, both restating the sentence above them; automation — the dates and money legacy → CEL bullets (`objectstack-formula`'s table), the CEL callout's restated pointer, the blueprint's restated layout, and three `runAs` / `readonly` notes tightened with no rule removed. Ceilings lowered to the measurement: `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 6012 → 6011, `objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 6450 → 6449, `examples-objects.md` 1769 → 1756; `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` stays 6123 at 6123. No ceiling rises.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/28577-adr-0146-skills-docs-teaching.md`, `@objectstack/skills` patch, both declaration lines.

## Why

ADR-0126 §8 item 5 asks the §1.3 promise pages to say what the customization model delivers once it has landed, "not before"; ADR-0146's rollout row N-30 is that correction, and every `Blocked-by:` card of #28577 closed by 2026-11-02 (the last, #28576, through #28850). Until this PR the skills still taught the paths D2, D4, D10 and D11 superseded.

## Verification

- `pnpm docs:build` — exit 0 under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, held 191 s); both new anchors (`#customizing-an-installed-packages-object`, `#customizing-an-installed-package-the-paired-custom-override-adr-0146`) resolve in the built pages.
- `pnpm check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `pnpm check:docs-audit-scope`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring` — exit 0 each.
- `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs origin/main` — "0 docs name something this change touched" (no `packages/**` change, as expected for a docs-and-skills PR); the accuracy pass was done by hand: each taught sentence was read against the door or test that pins it (`protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts#judgeOverrideWrite`, `packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal`, `protocol-extension-field-suffix.ts`, `protocol-object-extension-item.ts`, `protocol-customization-package.ts`, `commands/migrate/packageless-overlays.ts`, the studio i18n strings).
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` and `--self-test` — exit 0 (57 authored files within ceilings; self-test 97 cases).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run gen:skill-docs` / `gen:skill-refs` — regenerated, no diff.
- Derived gate family (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 92 commands) run on head `b91f8e6e8`: 89 of 92 exited 0 on the first pass; `check:skill-examples` refused (exit 3) for want of built declarations and exits 0 once `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/client` and `@objectstack/client-react` are built with declarations (281 marked blocks, including the new `defineObjectExtension` block in `object-extensions.mdx`); `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` are not measured in this tree (no full `pnpm build`; the diff touches no `packages/**`), so CI's run of those two is the reading. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` on the recorded exit codes: 92 derived, 91 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (no schema touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (repo-wide lint is CI's run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
